proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3197 kīdṛśa gives Marathi kasā, Old Marwari kiso and ka-replacement forms in Apabhramsha kaïsa/Hindi kaisā “of what kind?”. The survey forms have the same interrogative adjective meaning; vowel remodeling is retained rather than asserted to be mechanically regular.
